Ivy (Marketing): Quick sync — aiming to publish Tuesday 08:45 PT. Need final changelog line, canonical docs link, canary schedule, and webinar reg link for CTA. Can eng/docs/ops confirm? :hourglass:
Kai (Eng): We can start 08:45 PT. Canary plan: 3 phases — 2% for 20m, 20% for 20m, then 100% if healthy. Feature flag routing.quant_v1 will stay OFF during canary.
Jules (Docs): Canonical docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/188012. I'll lock edits at 08:20 PT and paste copy-ready changelog now.
Jules (Docs): Changelog (copy-ready): "Performance: ~22% lower median latency for long-context chat; added prefix KV cache to reduce repeated-prompt token usage. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/188012"
Sam (Ops): Lead webhook: https://hooks.redwood.ai/leads. Header x-source:marketing. SFDC campaign: "Launch_Tue_188012". Test payload responded 200 OK.
Ivy (Marketing): Webinar reg link?
Sam (Ops): Reg: https://events.redwood.ai/188012-reg, embed: https://events.redwood.ai/embed/188012.
Ivy (Marketing): UTM scheme? blog vs newsletter?
Sam (Ops): blog: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=launch_tue_188012; newsletter: utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=launch_tue_188012. Append &product_tag=rwd-v2-qa.
Kai (Eng): Deploy PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4180. Deploy TID tid-2026-06-12-3301. Monitoring: abort if p95 > 250ms for 5m or error-rate >0.8% for 3m. Rollback steps in PR.
deploy-bot: deploy tid-2026-06-12-3301 started to canary pool (2%) — logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/3301
Ivy (Marketing): Thanks — I'll schedule CMS at 08:45 PT and post final copy here at 08:25 PT for sign-off. Freezes: docs locked at 08:20 PT, content freeze 08:25 PT.
Kai (Eng): Noted. On-call: Kai + Sam during canary.
Ivy (Marketing): Closing for now, will ping for final sign-off. :rocket:
